COMMUNICATIONS PLATFORM AS A SERVICE
 
 
 
 
 
We Make Messaging Easy — So You Can Scale Smarter
 
 
 
 
 Drive customer engagement, subscriber retention, and new revenue streams through scalable, multichannel communications tailored to brands, telcos, and ISVs. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore Solutions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Trusted by over 
100+ 
companies. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Built for Scalable, Multichannel Engagement
 
 
 
 
 
 We Power Messaging Across Leading Channels
 
 
 
 
 Messangi’s platform supports seamless communication across today’s most powerful messaging channels, so your message is always delivered on the right platform, at the right time.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
what we do
 
 
 
 
 
Built for Engagement. Designed for Growth.
 
 
 
 
 We help brands, telcos, and software providers scale meaningful connections through automation, personalization, and real-time messaging across SMS, WhatsApp, Email, RCS, Push, and Voice. Our platform powers branded CPaaS for telcos, messaging APIs for ISVs, high-ROI campaigns for enterprises, and subscriber engagement through chatbots, wallets, and gamification. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get started now
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Engagement Solutions for Brands
 
 
 
 
 
Deliver the right message to the right person at the right time — and on the right channel
 
 
 
 
 Whether you’re launching a new promotion or automating support, we give you the tools to drive conversions and retain customers.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore by Product
 
 
 
 
 
While our solutions span multiple use cases, you can also explore specific tools that power them.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Live Chat 
 
 
Messaging contact center solution
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Broadcast
 
 
Multichannel Messaging Platform
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Chatbot
 
 
Chatbots & Automation
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
White-Label CPaaS for Telcos
 
 
 
 
 
Turn messaging infrastructure into a growth engine
 
 
 
 
 We help telecom operators launch fully branded CPaaS platforms — customizable, multichannel, and ready to scale. Go beyond SMS with WhatsApp, Email, RCS, Voice, and more, all seamlessly integrated with your existing systems. Our solution includes real-time analytics, onboarding, and go-to-market support, so you can focus on growing enterprise relationships while we handle the tech.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore Telco Partnerships
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Subscriber Monetization & Engagement
 
 
 
 
 
We help telcos and brands engage and monetize their mobile subscribers
 
 
 
 
 Boost interaction and retention with gamified promos and digital loyalty cards for Apple and Google Wallet. Use surveys, onboarding flows, and behavioral triggers to launch timely, multichannel campaigns via SMS, WhatsApp, Email, and more. With Messangi, engagement drives revenue. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Messaging APIs & Partnerships for ISVs
 
 
 
 
 
Expand Your Software’s Value with Built-In Messaging
 
 
 
 
 Easily integrate scalable, multichannel messaging into your software solutions via our flexible APIs. Embed SMS, WhatsApp, Email, RCS, and push notifications directly into your platform to enhance your product offering and user experience, backed by comprehensive documentation and dedicated support. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore ISV Partnerships
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Let’s Build What’s Next in Messaging
 
 
 
 
 Schedule a call to see how Messangi can help your team drive results across every channel.

 Get expert insights on engagement, retention, and messaging. Explore real strategies to grow your business faster.

Broadcast solution
 
 
 
 
 
Communicate with your audience quickly and efficiently with a Bulk Messaging Solution
 
 
 
 
 Send messages to your customers across channels to ensure your communications are read and acted upon 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Talk to an expert
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Transform Your Communication Strategy: Broadcast Makes It Simple and Efficient
 
 
 
 
 
As a communications/marketing executive or business owner, optimizing customer engagement is crucial. Juggling multiple platforms for each channel is inefficient and limits your reach. Broadcast solves these challenges with a unified platform, streamlining messaging, extending reach, and enhancing engagement.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Send messages to your audience effectively
 
 
 
 
 Ensure your messages are read and acted upon 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get started now
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Instant Delivery
 
 
Send time-sensitive info to thousands simultaneously with a click, enabling prompt customer engagement
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Scalability
 
 
Scale your business messages from hundreds to millions, adapting effortlessly to your audience growth
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
High Open Rates
 
 
Maximize reach by ensuring most of your target audience views your messages through mobile channels
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Broadcasts, send messages at scale
 
 
 
 
 Facilitate the delivery of messages to specific distribution groups through designated channels. Communicate on a mass scale, allowing for widespread transmission of vital information or marketing campaigns.​ 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Features
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Template Manager
 
 
Create/manage templates for SMS, WhatsApp, Email, Push, RCS on our platform, intuitively channel-adapting
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Segmentation and personalization
 
 
Leverage placeholders to customize messages, aligning with specific audience preferences
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
URL Shortner
 
 
Enhance engagement with our URL Shortener: offers custom domains, character optimization, unique URLs, and click tracking
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Delivery Reports
 
 
Detailed Reporting provides insights on message delivery, read rates, and link engagement for optimized communication
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Subscription and Consent Management
 
 
Efficiently manage subscription lists for respectful, precise targeting of opted-in recipients only
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Use Cases
 
 
 
 
 Messangi’s broadcast module is leveraged daily by numerous teams across diverse markets to dispatch bulk messaging communications efficiently.​ 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Public Awareness and Outreach
Broadly reach a large audience through efficient SMS blasts, raising awareness and boosting participation
 
 
 
 
 
 
Promotions
Use mobile messages to share promotions, inform about your sale or new product, enticing them to make a purchase, thereby driving up your revenue.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Emergency Alerts
Use broadcast tools to inform and guide your community during a crisis instantly; you're better equipped to keep everyone safe.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Internal Communications
Ensure employee updates and event reminders are promptly received and actioned using broadcasts
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Unleash the power of effective, efficient, and scalable messaging
